tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: Canadian provinces (and the territories) with land for sale on AcreScout, each with its listing count, median asking price, median asking price per acre of bare land 10+ acres, and its regions (counties, regional districts, Quebec admin regions) with their listing counts. Use a region's slug in sear

tools.name: search_land
tools.description: Land and acreages for sale in one Canadian province, from Kijiji (realtor listings), Centris and Zillow ads, refreshed several times a day. Filters on region, price, acreage, water frontage, AcreScout's value check and how recently it was listed. Returns at most 20 listings with price, acres, price

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: One AcreScout listing by its id (8 hex characters, as in https://acrescout.ca/#l=<id>) or its acrescout.ca/land/... page URL: price, size, price per acre, place, how exact the map point is, water, value check, listed date and price cuts, with links.
